text: SIPROTEC 7VE85 is a modular paralleling device that synchronizes generators with the power grid or two electricity-supply systems for stable, efficient power distribution.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7VE85?

text: Fluctuating operating conditions can pose challenges for safe, reliable power system synchronization. SIPROTEC 7VE85 solves this with multi-channel redundancy, duplicated hardware and diverse measuring algorithms to prevent systematic errors. The device automatically adjusts to synchronous or asynchronous conditions for precise switching.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7VE85?

text: Use 1.5- and 2-channel synchronization functions for adaptability across generator and system sizes. The modular structure and DIGSI 5 engineering tool allow you to integrate protection and control into one device. Eliminate external switchover of synchronization and voltage measuring points to save costs.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7VE85?

text: Synchronize generators and electricity systems reliably. Our multichannel redundancy delivers operational security in critical infrastructure to minimize risk.
heading: Synchronize your system

text: Reduce operational complexity, improve efficiency and save costs by eliminating external switchover requirements.
heading: Reduce costs

text: Apply robust cybersecurity features like role-based access control and signed firmware. Protect your systems to meet NERC CIP and BDEW Whitepaper requirements.
heading: Strengthen cybersecurity

text: The following modes of operation are covered: switching synchronous/ asynchronous electrical power systems, switching to de-energized line or dead busbar, synchro check function and adjusting commands for voltage and frequency.
